# toKebabCase

<link-summary>Rewrites a string in kebab-case.</link-summary>

<web-summary>toKebabCase() — Rewrites a string in kebab-case. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function toKebabCase(value: string, options: ToKebabCaseOptions = {}): string;
```

Spaces and underscores become hyphens, a hyphen is inserted where a lower-case letter meets an upper-case one, and the result is lowered. That second rule is what splits `"userFirstName"` into three words.

`clean` removes anything that is not a letter, a digit or a hyphen; `trim` collapses the surrounding whitespace first.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                 | Description                                                                       |
| :---------------------------- | :------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                       | `string`             | The string to convert. It must not be empty.                                      |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `ToKebabCaseOptions` | `clean` removes the remaining punctuation; `trim` trims and collapses whitespace. |

## Returns

`string` — the converted string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
toKebabCase("Hello World"); // => "hello-world"
toKebabCase("userFirstName"); // => "user-first-name"
```
